__inputs.name: DS_INFLUXDB
__inputs.label: InfluxDB (Flux)
__inputs.description: Fonte de dados InfluxDB Cloud (linguagem Flux)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "iluminacao")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "iluminacao_ods7" and r._field == "potencia_efetiva_W")
  |> group(columns: ["cenario"])
  |> integral(unit: 1h)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value / 1000.0}))
  |> keep(columns: ["cenario", "_value"])

panels.title: Economia percentual de energia (B vs A)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "iluminacao")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "iluminacao_ods7" and r._field == "potencia_efetiva_W")
  |> group(columns: ["cenario"])
  |> integral(unit: 1h)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_start"], columnKey: ["cenario"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: (r.A - r.B) / r.A * 100.0}))

from(bucket: "iluminacao")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "iluminacao_ods7" and r._field == "potencia_efetiva_W")
  |> group(columns: ["cenario"])
  |> integral(unit: 1h)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_start"], columnKey: ["cenario"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: (r.A - r.B) / 1000.0}))

from(bucket: "iluminacao")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "iluminacao_ods7" and r._field == "potencia_efetiva_W")
  |> group(columns: ["cenario"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value / 60.0 / 1000.0}))
  |> cumulativeSum()

panels.title: Tempo com a luminária ligada (cenário B)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "iluminacao")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "iluminacao_ods7" and r._field == "estado_real" and r.cenario == "B")
  |> group()
  |> integral(unit: 1h)
